title: Fix table export failure when active date filters are applied
summary: Export button fails silently when date range filters are applied, preventing users from downloading filtered tabular data.
markdown_body:
## Problem
When exporting reports with active date filters, the export process terminates without generating or downloading the CSV file.

## Actual behavior
Clicking 'Export CSV' displays a transient loading spinner, but no download begins and no user-facing error message is shown.

## Expected behavior
The filtered dataset should be serialized and downloaded as a CSV file matching the selected date range criteria.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Navigate to Reports view
2. Set Date Range filter to Last 30 Days
3. Click Export CSV button

## Environment
Chrome 130 on Windows 11

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Export initiates correctly when date range filters are active
- [ ] Exported CSV contents match the filtered records exactly
- [ ] Appropriate error notification is displayed if serialization fails
- [ ] Unit and integration tests added for filter export serialization
